description_en: Modifies a single origin address pool specified by the origin address pool ID
description_zh: 修改单个源地址池，传入源地址池ID指定单个源地址池，进行修改
name: UpdateOriginPool

parameters.help_en: The origin address pool ID. You can call the [ListOriginPools](~~ListOriginPools~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池ID，可通过调用[ListOriginPools](~~ListOriginPools~~)接口获取
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the origin address pool is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
parameters.help_zh:
源地址池是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用
parameters.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The addresses of the origin server, such as www.example.com
fields.name: address

fields.help_en: The AccessKey required for private authentication
fields.name: access_key

fields.help_en:
The authentication type. Valid values:

public: public read/write. Use this value when the origin server is OSS or S3 with public read/write access.
private_same_account: private same-account. Use this value when the origin server is OSS with same-account private authentication.
private_cross_account: private cross-account. Use this value when the origin server is OSS with cross-account private authentication.
private: Use this value when the origin server is S3 with private authentication
fields.help_zh:
鉴权类型。

public：公共读写，源站为OSS或S3且为公共读写时使用；
private_same_account：私有同账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为同账号私有鉴权时使用；
private_cross_account：私有跨账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为跨账号私有鉴权时使用；
private：源站为S3，且鉴权类型为私有时使用
fields.name: auth_type

fields.help_en: The region of the origin server required when the origin server is AWS S3
fields.help_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的源站region
fields.name: region

fields.help_en: The SecretKey required for private authentication
fields.name: secret_key

fields.help_en: The signature version required when the origin server is AWS S3
fields.help_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的签名版本
fields.name: version

fields.help_en: The authentication information. This parameter is required when the origin server is OSS, S3, or another origin server that requires authentication
fields.help_zh: 鉴权信息，源站为OSS或者S3等源站需要鉴权时，需要传鉴权相关配置信息
fields.name: auth_conf

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the origin server is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
fields.help_zh:
源站是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The request header included in back-to-origin requests. Only Host is supported
fields.help_zh: 回源时带的请求头，只支持Host
fields.name: header

fields.help_en:
The IP protocol version used for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:
round_robin: default policy. Randomly polls IPv4 or IPv6 origin servers.
ipv4_first: preferentially uses IPv4 origin servers.
ipv6_first: preferentially uses IPv6 origin servers.
follow: preferentially follows the IP version used by the client
fields.help_zh:
回源请求使用的 IP 协议版本：
round_robin：默认策略，随机轮询 IPv4 或 IPv6 源站
ipv4_first：优先使用 IPv4 源站
ipv6_first：优先使用 IPv6 源站
follow：优先跟随客户端使用的 IP 版本
fields.name: ip_version_policy

fields.help_en: The origin server name. The name must be unique within an origin address pool
fields.help_zh: 源站名称，一个源地址下源站名称唯一
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The origin server type. Valid values:

ip_domain: an IP address or domain name-based origin server.
OSS: an OSS address-based origin server.
S3: an AWS S3 origin server
fields.help_zh:
源站类型：

ip_domain: ip或域名类型源站；
OSS：OSS地址源站；
S3：AWS S3源站
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The weight. The value is an integer from 0 to 100
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The origin server information added to the origin address pool. Use an array to pass multiple origin servers
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息，多个源站使用数组传值
parameters.name: origins

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id
